messages:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: GPU prefill OOMs on gpu-pool-7 causing container restarts across node-7a,node-7b. Service: runtime-prefill. Alert ID: 6234567000. Link: https://redwood.prod/incidents/6234567000
maria: on-call. got it, looking. assigning pager.
raj: looking at kube logs; seeing CUDA 'illegal memory access' + prefill spikes. posting trimmed logs.
raj: ```
2024-11-12T03:20:12Z runtime: prefill size=1.2M tokens -> OOM
E/CUDA: cuCtxSynchronize failed: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION
container restart: exit code 137
```
sara: short-term mitigations: 1) set per-request prefill token cap -> 65,536 tokens; 2) reduce kvcache prefetch factor to 0.3; 3) route large-context (>256k tokens) to fallback-model-cpu. I'll patch flags now.
maria: can someone flip the prod flag? want to avoid config churn.
sara: command to patch: `PATCH /flags/prefill-cap {"cap_tokens":65536}`
raj: applying cap now -> `curl -X PATCH https://flags.prod/api/flags/prefill-cap -d '{"cap_tokens":65536}'` -> 200 OK
incident-bot: mitigation applied: cap_tokens=65536 on runtime-prefill. Observability: error rate dropping.
leo: customer-ops: two customers reported timeouts earlier (acme-inc, fastchat). need initial comms.
maria: i'll send a short customer notice: timeline + mitigation + ask to expect degraded large-context handling. drafting.
leo: confirmed affected list: acme-inc, datawise, fastchat (enterprise tiers).
jess: propose cordon node-7b and drain, suspicious node hit repeated restarts.
raj: starting cordon: `kubectl cordon node-7b` then `kubectl drain node-7b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> draining
sara: also enabling autoscale burst to move load to dedicated CPU fallback pool.
raj: found driver mismatch on node-7b (525.xx) vs fleet standard (530.xx) — likely culprit for CUDA illegal instr.
maria: action items: (1) complete node drain (raj), (2) schedule driver rollout to 530.xx (eng-runtime), (3) customer comms (maria+leo), (4) postmortem owner (sara). handoff to night rotation in ~2h.
leo: customer notice sent: "We observed GPU prefill OOMs causing restarts. We applied caps and rerouted large-context requests. No data exposure. We'll follow up with technical details." :email:
maria: ack. metrics: error rate down ~85% within 10m of mitigation. holding oncall until stable.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2; timeline updated.
raj: leaving ops notes in runbook: suspect driver mismatch + aggressive kvcache prefetch. opening bug/PR: https://redwood.prod/bugs/PR-9991
sara: thanks all. handing overnight watch to @jess — please escalate if >10% error rate sustained.
jess: ack, taking watch. ping me oncall if issues persist.
